entities.summary: Enrique Cabrera is a Mexican sculptor, photographer, musician and restorer. He began his career doing restoration projects with the Government of Mexico, and created his first collection of sculptures, titled Trilogía, in 2010. Since then, his works have been exhibited in places like the Louvre Museum and the Musée Picasso.
